description: This file defines a final class ThingPersistenceActor that extends an abstract sharded persistence actor, managing the state of individual 'Thing' objects in a distributed system with persistence, snapshotting, and event handling capabilities. It contains methods for creating actor Props, managing persistence identifiers, and handling recovery of 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: ThingPersistenceActor
classes.description: A persistence actor managing the state of a single 'Thing' entity, supporting persistence, snapshotting, and event publication in a distributed environment.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props configuration for spawning a ThingPersistenceActor with specified ThingId, DistributedPub, and optional SnapshotAdapter.

methods.name: persistenceId
methods.description: Returns the unique persistence identifier for the actor, combining a prefix with the entity ID.

methods.name: journalPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID used for journaling persistency.

methods.name: snapshotPluginId
methods.description: Returns the plugin ID used for snapshotting persistency.

methods.name: getEventClass
methods.description: Specifies the class type of events this actor handles.

methods.name: getStrategyContext
methods.description: Provides the context for command strategies, including logging and entity ID.

methods.name: getCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy used when creating a 'Thing'.

methods.name: getDeletedStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the command strategy used when deleting a 'Thing'.

methods.name: getEventStrategy
methods.description: Provides the event strategy for handling 'Thing' events.

methods.name: getActivityCheckConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration related to activity checks for persistence.

methods.name: getSnapshotConfig
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for snapshotting of 'Thing' entities.

methods.name: entityExistsAsDeleted
methods.description: Checks whether the current entity exists in a 'deleted' lifecycle state.

methods.name: newNotAccessibleExceptionBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder for exceptions when a 'Thing' entity is not accessible.

methods.name: recoveryCompleted
methods.description: Handles the completion of recovery, updating entity state and logging.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Publishes a 'Thing' event to the distributed pubsub system.

methods.name: getEntitySchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version implemented by a 'Thing' entity.
